<div class="project-stack">
  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/triton-flash-attention" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="project-row-title">Triton FlashAttention-2: Forward Attention</span>
    <span class="project-row-meta">FA2-style forward attention with online softmax, FP16 MHA/GQA at D=32/64/128, causal tile pruning, and masking for partial sequence tiles. Passed 60/60 CUDA cases against PyTorch SDPA with maximum absolute error 2.44 × 10<sup>−4</sup>. On RTX 5050 at causal B=1, H=16, N=511, D=64, measured 1.15×/1.13× versus eager/torch.compile SDPA using the default backend.</span>
  </a>
</div>
